cohort: 11 women aged 23-38 years who underwent cesarean delivery at 39.1-40.2 weeks gestational age
finding: Skin-to-skin contact (SSC) after cesarean delivery facilitates mutual caregiving between mother and neonate, characterized by a shared and reciprocal relationship.
mod_finding: This study investigates the experience of mothers holding their neonates in skin-to-skin contact (SSC) immediately after cesarean delivery.
